# unifi_wans (Data Source)

Lists the WAN interfaces of a site via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication. The `id` is the Official API UUID (used e.g. as a member of the External firewall zone); the same value is exposed as `official_id` on `unifi_network`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires a controller running 10.1.78+ with API-key authentication (Official API).
data "unifi_wans" "all" {}

# Official API UUID of a WAN, looked up by name.
locals {
  wan1_official_id = one([for w in data.unifi_wans.all.wans : w.id if w.name == "Internet 1"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing WAN interfaces.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `wans` (Attributes List) The WAN interfaces defined on the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wans))

<a id="nestedatt--wans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wans`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The Official API UUID of the WAN interface.
- `name` (String) The name of the WAN interface.
